# Recycle compressor K-301 manual

## 5 Surge protection

Stage 1 of the recycle compressor K-301 is monitored by vibration probes, bearing temperature elements and a discharge pressure transmitter, and each reading is logged to the historian every second for trend review by the rotating equipment engineer. Stage 2 of the recycle compressor K-301 is monitored by vibration probes, bearing temperature elements and a discharge pressure transmitter, and each reading is logged to the historian every second for trend review by the rotating equipment engineer. Stage 3 of the recycle compressor K-301 is monitored by vibration probes, bearing temperature elements and a discharge pressure transmitter, and each reading is logged to the historian every second for trend review by the rotating equipment engineer. Stage 4 of the recycle compressor K-301 is monitored by vibration probes, bearing temperature elements and a discharge pressure transmitter, and each reading is logged to the historian every second for trend review by the rotating equipment engineer. Stage 5 of the recycle compressor K-301 is monitored by vibration probes, bearing temperature elements and a discharge pressure transmitter, and each reading is logged to the historian every second for trend review by the rotating equipment engineer. Stage 6 of the recycle compressor K-301 is monitored by vibration probes, bearing temperature elements and a discharge pressure transmitter, and each reading is logged to the historian every second for trend review by the rotating equipment engineer. Stage 7 of the recycle compressor K-301 is monitored by vibration probes, bearing temperature elements and a discharge pressure transmitter, and each reading is logged to the historian every second for trend review by the rotating equipment engineer. Stage 8 of the recycle compressor K-301 is monitored by vibration probes, bearing temperature elements and a discharge pressure transmitter, and each reading is logged to the historian every second for trend review by the rotating equipment engineer. The anti-surge valve UV-301 must reach its fully open position within 1.2 seconds of a surge-line crossing.
